readings: Using transaction records joined to traders (trdref = tradereg, exact match, dropping unmatched records), count the number of transaction records for each trader type (tradekind), with traders that have no type forming their own group. Return the types whose record count is strictly above the plain average of the per-type record counts. For each, show the type, its record count, the count divided by the total of all per-type counts, and the count minus the average. Don't round anything, and return nothing if the average is missing.

Using transaction records joined to traders (trdref = tradereg, exact match, dropping unmatched records), count the number of distinct traders that have at least one matched transaction record, for each trader type (tradekind), with traders that have no type forming their own group. Return the types whose distinct-trader count is strictly above the plain average of the per-type distinct-trader counts. For each, show the type, its distinct-trader count, the count divided by the total of all per-type counts, and the count minus the average. Don't round anything, and return nothing if the average is missing.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tk, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM transactionrecord r
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
s AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc, SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM c
)
SELECT c.tk AS tradekind, c.cnt AS record_count, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.tot AS share, c.cnt - s.avgc AS diff_from_avg
FROM c, s
WHERE s.avgc IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avgc

WITH c AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS cnt
  FROM transactionrecord r
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
s AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM c
)
SELECT c.tradekind,
       c.cnt,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_cnt,
       c.cnt - s.avg_cnt
FROM c, s
WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avg_cnt;
